name: XLA_FSN_EVENTS_INT
description: This table contains the set of events that is to be processed by a run of the accounting engine.

columns.name: REPORT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request identifier of original request.

columns.name: PARENT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Request identifier of parent request.

columns.name: EVENT_SET_ID
columns.description: Event set that this event has been grouped into.

columns.name: PROCESSING_ORDER
columns.description: Order on how accounting events are processed.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: EVENT_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the categorization of accounting events that is unique within an application and event class.

columns.name: ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Identifies subledger transactions associated with the accounting events.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of transaction event.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event class and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Unique abbreviated name assigned to an event type and used for reporting or in reference to an option.

columns.name: EVENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifying number of an accounting event.

columns.name: EVENT_DATE
columns.description: Date when an accounting event is created.

columns.name: EVENT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Event status code at the start of the run.

columns.name: PROCESS_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Event process status at the start of the run.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_NUMBER
columns.description: Transaction number associated with the transaction entity of the event.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID_INT_1
columns.description: Source identifier associated with the transaction entity of the event.

columns.description: Source identifier associated with the transaction entity of the event.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_ID
columns.description: Legal entity associated with the transaction entity of the event.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_BATCH_ID
columns.description: Stores XLA_AE_HEADERS.ACCOUNTING_BATCH_ID

columns.name: LOCKING_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: The request identifier for the accounting engine that has locked the event for processing in an accounting run. The value is blank if the engine is not able to lock the event.
